name: Nepal
shortSummary: India and Nepal share an open border, deep cultural and religious ties, and a special relationship formalized in the 1950 Treaty of Peace and Friendship, though the relationship periodically strains over border and sovereignty issues.
complexity: A 2020 Nepali political map claiming Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura — territory India administers — remains an unresolved friction point. A 2015-16 border blockade also left lasting resentment in Nepal.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Indian public-sector investment in Nepali hydropower projects such as Arun-III.
Nepali citizens can live and work in India without a visa, and vice versa.

majorChallenges.title: Kalapani-Lipulekh border dispute
majorChallenges.description: Overlapping territorial claims remain unresolved despite multiple rounds of talks.

recentDevelopments.title: Hydropower cooperation expands
recentDevelopments.description: Cross-border electricity trade under the 2014 Power Trade Agreement continued expanding, with new hydropower projects progressing.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Deepens economic interdependence even as the Kalapani-Lipulekh border dispute remains unresolved.

historicalEvents.title: Treaty of Peace and Friendship
historicalEvents.description: India and Nepal sign a treaty establishing open borders and reciprocal rights of movement, residence and property for citizens.

historicalEvents.title: Border Blockade
historicalEvents.description: Months-long disruption of supplies at the India-Nepal border coincides with unrest over Nepal's new constitution, straining ties.

historicalEvents.title: Kalapani-Lipulekh Map Dispute
historicalEvents.description: Nepal issues a revised political map including Kalapani, Lipulekh and Limpiyadhura, which India administers; the dispute remains unresolved.

agreements.name: Treaty of Peace and Friendship
agreements.description: Foundational treaty granting citizens of each country reciprocal rights.

agreements.name: Power Trade Agreement
agreements.description: Framework for cross-border electricity trade and hydropower development.

defenceCooperation.name: Honorary Gorkha regiments
defenceCooperation.description: India continues the long-standing recruitment of Nepali Gorkha soldiers into the Indian Army.

trade.majorExports: Petroleum products, vehicles, machinery, iron and steel
